title: Optimal Algorithms for Nonsmooth Nonconvex Stochastic Optimization with Constraints
abstract: arXiv:2610.13787v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We present new algorithms for stochastic optimization problems in which the objective is neither smooth nor convex, subject to a convex constraint set. Our algorithms return a $(\delta,\varepsilon)$-Goldstein stationary point, as recently defined for constrained problems by Liu et al. (2024), with improved complexities, and are the first to achieve optimal convergence rates for this task in several settings. In particular, we design projection-based and projection-free algorithms that achieve a $\widetilde O(\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ rate using stochastic gradients, which we show to be optimal, and a $\widetilde O(d\delta^{-1}\varepsilon^{-3})$ rate using zeroth-order queries, which is also optimal in its dependence on the dimension $d$ and improves over prior work. translated_title: 带约束的非光滑非凸随机优化的最优算法
translated_abstract: 我们针对一类随机优化问题提出了新的算法，该类问题的目标函数既不光滑也不凸，且受到凸约束集的限制。我们的算法能够返回一个 (δ,ε)-Goldstein 驻点（该概念是 Liu 等人于 2024 年针对约束问题最近定义的），并具有改进的复杂度，且是首个在若干设定下针对该任务达到最优收敛率的算法。特别地，我们设计了基于投影和无投影（projection-free）的两类算法：使用随机梯度时可达到 Õ(δ⁻¹ε⁻³) 的速率，我们证明了该速率是最优的；使用零阶查询时可达到 Õ(dδ⁻¹ε⁻³) 的速率，该速率在维度 d 的依赖关系上也是最优的，并改进了先前的工作。值得注意的是，我们的下界是以 Frank-Wolfe 间隙的形式给出的，并且即使对于光滑问题也成立，这具有独立的学术价值。这些结果表明……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了求解带凸约束的非光滑非凸随机优化问题的新算法，首次在多种设定下达到最优收敛率：使用随机梯度时复杂度为 Õ(δ⁻¹ε⁻³)，使用零阶查询时复杂度为 Õ(dδ⁻¹ε⁻³)。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes new algorithms for constrained nonsmooth nonconvex stochastic optimization that achieve optimal convergence rates—Õ(δ⁻¹ε⁻³) with stochastic gradients and Õ(dδ⁻¹ε⁻³) with zeroth-order queries—for finding (δ,ε)-Goldstein stationary points.
